name: completeness-classify
description: Calibration harness orchestration: routes a CRITERIA/OUTPUT pair through judge-completeness and emits the CHOSEN score as its output (each branch is a code node returning its own name). The judge replies with a coverage fraction; this harness calibrates against its three documented anchor scores (1.0 = everything covered, 0.5 = half covered, 0.0 = nothing covered), so dataset rows are engineered to land exactly on an anchor. Pair with datasets/completeness-calibration.json + evals/completeness-calibration.json.
